description: This file contains functions for resolving Discord group policies, including guild and channel entries, and determining whether to require mentions or apply specific tool policies based on context.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordSlug
methods.description: Normalizes a Discord slug or identifier using string normalization.

methods.name: resolveDiscordGuildEntry
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate Discord guild entry based on provided guilds and group space.

methods.name: resolveDiscordChannelEntry
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate Discord channel entry based on channel entries and parameters.

methods.name: resolveSenderToolsEntry
methods.description: Resolves the tool policy for a sender based on the entry and context.

methods.name: resolveDiscordPolicyContext
methods.description: Builds the context for Discord policy resolution, including guild and channel entries.

methods.name: resolveDiscordGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Determines if a Discord group requires mention based on context.

methods.name: resolveDiscordGroupToolPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the tool policy for a Discord group based on context.
